# Calibrating the EPMA

## Setting the EOS conditions and focusing
::: columns
::: column
The first thing to do is setting the correct kV and nA, and focusing the machine, which is done with the EOS parameters such as focusing and stigmators.
:::
::: column
{{< video https://youtu.be/Qlb-edi-5iY >}}
:::
:::

## Element calibration
::: columns
::: column
This illustrates how EOS conditions are read in, points are set on a standard, peak search is executed, the PHA of the detector is determined, and how this is done for all the elements in a measurement recipe using a serial analysis.
:::
::: column
{{< video https://youtu.be/fnd39-GBa5M >}}
:::
:::
